resources.string: Manual checks using ipify and Akamai. Xray uses its local proxy; Amnezia uses VPN. This does not test every app. Results stay in memory.

This sends small IP and DNS checks directly over your current internet to ipify and Akamai, while VPN is disconnected. Connect the VPN afterwards and check again on the same network within 30 minutes. Nothing is saved to disk.
DNS leak status unknown. This Xray proxy check cannot measure Android or other apps’ DNS paths.
This check needs Android 11+ and a supported active VPN route. Xray requires a local SOCKS listener without authentication; root and proxy-only modes are not measured.
